title: Da-Cheng-Qi decoction attenuates inflammatory edema and endoplasmic reticulum stress in acute pancreatitis via suppressing NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Shang, Jinfeng; Ma, Liping; Su, Rui; Jiang, Xinru; Jiang, Yani; Fan, Youmin; Wang, Yanmin; Li, Xueqi; You, Meiyi; Tian, Zhaoxing; Wang, Jingjuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大承气汤通过抑制NF-kappaB通路减轻急性胰腺炎炎症水肿和内质网应激，虽含分子对接/MD验证药物-蛋白结合，但核心是药物作用机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Da-Cheng-Qi Decoction (DCQD) is clinically used for acute pancreatitis (AP). AP is an inflammatory disorder, characterized by inflammatory edema (IE) and endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS). AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to investigate whether DCQD attenuates IE and ERS in AP via nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In vivo, an AP model was established in Balb/c mice via L-arginine intraperitoneal injection (24 h); in vitro, an AP model was induced in rat pancreatic exocrine cells (AR42J) using cerulein (24 h). Mice were treated with DCQD (18 g/kg, 9 g/kg, and 4.5 g/kg); cells received DCQD-containing serum (5%, 2.5% and 1.25%). Network pharmacology, transcriptomics and non-targeted metabolomics were performed to predict core pathway. Pharmacological modulation employed NF-kappaB agonist and inhibitor. Docking and molecular dynamics (MD) validated interactions between core DCQD compound and proteins. Several pharmacological indicators tests and molecular biological assessments were conducted. RESULTS: Network pharmacology identified 138 DCQD targets overlapping with AP, with NF-kappaB pathway as a core pathway. Docking/MD demonstrated strong binding affinity between rhein and NF-kappaB. In vivo, DCQD (9 g/kg or 2.5% drug-containing serum) significantly lowered pancreas coefficient, decreased serum alpha-amylase and interleukin-6 (IL-6), and attenuated pancreatic Na(+) accumulation and Ca(2+) depletion. In vitro, DCQD-containing serum increased cell viability, suppressed IL-6, and modulated ion imbalance. Mechanistically, DCQD down-regulated NF-kappaB, IE-related proteins and ERS-related proteins. The NF-kappaB inhibitor enhanced DCQD's protective effects, while the NF-kappaB agonist counteracted them. CONCLUSION: DCQD ameliorates IE and ERS in AP, primarily through suppressing NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：大承气汤（DCQD）临床用于治疗急性胰腺炎（AP）。AP是一种炎症性疾病，以炎性水肿（IE）和内质网应激（ERS）为特征。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨DCQD是否通过核因子kappaB（NF-kappaB）通路减轻AP中的IE和ERS。材料与方法：在体内，通过L-精氨酸腹腔注射（24小时）在Balb/c小鼠中建立AP模型；在体外，使用雨蛙素（24小时）在大鼠胰腺外分泌细胞（AR42J）中诱导AP模型。小鼠给予DCQD（18 g/kg、9 g/kg和4.5 g/kg）；细胞接受含DCQD血清（5%、2.5%和1.25%）。采用网络药理学、转录组学和非靶向代谢组学预测核心通路。药理学调节使用NF-kappaB激动剂和抑制剂。对接和分子动力学（MD）验证了DCQD核心化合物与蛋白质之间的相互作用。进行了多项药理学指标测试和分子生物学评估。结果：网络药理学鉴定出138个与AP重叠的DCQD靶点，其中NF-kappaB通路为核心通路。对接/MD显示大黄酸与NF-kappaB之间具有强结合亲和力。在体内，DCQD（9 g/kg或2.5%含药血清）显著降低胰腺系数，降低血清α-淀粉酶和白细胞介素-6（IL-6），并减轻胰腺Na(+)积累和Ca(2+)耗竭。在体外，含DCQD血清增加细胞活力，抑制IL-6，并调节离子失衡。机制上，DCQD下调NF-kappaB、IE相关蛋白和ERS相关蛋白。NF-kappaB抑制剂增强了DCQD的保护作用，而NF-kappaB激动剂则抵消了这些作用。结论：DCQD主要通过抑制NF-kappaB通路改善AP中的IE和ERS。
